description: The 2026-07-28 blocker recurred once. First Submit on PAY3061 returned 500 (elementId Activity_0e0c34w, TargetInvocationException) with NO UI feedback; an identical retry 16 s later returned 200. A controlled second registration (PAY3065) passed on its first Submit, so the fault is intermittent, not deterministic. Workaround: click Submit again. Bug: test-reports/bugs/2026-07-29-bas-register-upload-submit-500-intermittent.md
